title: Te Tūroro
intro: I ngā rā o mua, i ngā rā tōmua o te hītori o te tangata, e rua ngā wairua i tū ki mua i tō rātou Kaihanga me ā rātou whakahere. Kotahi i manakohia, kotahi i kore. Ko te mea i muri mai ka waiho hei aituā nui tuatahi i waenganui i ngā tuākana me ngā teina - he mahi manawanui, he mahi rapu utu kino. Ka taea e koe te hura ko wai ahau?
clues: I whānau mai ahau i ngā rā tuatahi o te oranga o te tangata ki te whenua
He tamaiti ahau nō te tokorua tuatahi i hikoi i tēnei ao
I tētahi wā i patua e au tētahi patunga tapu nō te mea pai rawa atu o taku kahui hei whakamanawareka i tōku Kaihanga
I manakohia taku whakahere e te rangi, ko te whakahere a taku tuakana/teina i whakakahoretia.
I te wā i whakawehia ai ahau ki te mate, i whiriwhiria e au kia kaua e totoro atu tōku ringa ki tōku tuakana/teina
Ko au te tangata tuatahi i roto i te hītori o te tangata i patua hetia e tetahi atu

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Hāpiri (Āpera), te tama a Ātama
Ko Qabil (Kaina), te tama a Ātama
Ātama, te tangata tuatahi
Noa (Noah)
Āperahama

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Ko te kohuru tuatahi i roto i te hītori o te tangata
Te waipuke nui o Noa
Te whakangaromanga o te ope a Parao
Te patunga tapu a Ibrahim i a Ismail
Te whawhai ki a Jalut (Goliata)
trial.answer: Ko te kohuru tuatahi i roto i te hītori o te tangata

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: He hipi i tukua hei patunga tapu e manakohia ana
He āaka rakau nui
He tokotoko i huri hei nakahi
He manu hūpō e kawe ana i te karere kingi
He awaawa ahi e mura ana
location.answer: He hipi i tukua hei patunga tapu e manakohia ana

outcome.label: Hua
options: Ko ia te patunga tuatahi o te kohuru i roto i te hītori o te tangata
I ora i te waipuke nui i roto i te waka rakau
I noho i roto i te puku o te ika nui
I whakahaere i ngā jinn, i ngā tāngata, me te hau
I kopikopiko mō ngā tau e whā tekau i roto i te koraha nui
outcome.answer: Ko ia te patunga tuatahi o te kohuru i roto i te hītori o te tangata

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
